name: Riverside Easy Loop
description: Flat out-and-back along the river path. Our default Tuesday night route — good for newer runners or an easy recovery day.

name: Millpond Tempo
description: Rolling hills around the pond with one sustained climb at mile 3. Popular for tempo workouts on Thursdays.

name: Ridge Climb
description: The long Sunday route. Two real climbs and a fast descent back into town. Bring water in summer.
